achievements.name: Captain
achievements.description: Complete the campaign on Easy difficulty.

achievements.name: Admiral
achievements.description: Complete the campaign on Medium difficulty.

achievements.name: Navigator
achievements.description: Complete the campaign on Hard difficulty.

achievements.name: Shall We Play a Game?
achievements.description: Successfully complete a War Games session for the first time.

achievements.name: Chapel Perilous
achievements.description: Survive the Asteroid Storm (a campaign-mission objective).

achievements.name: Untouchable
achievements.description: Complete 5 missions without the Mothership being hit by enemy fire.

achievements.name: Bug Swatter
achievements.description: Eliminate 200 total enemy strikecraft in the campaign.

achievements.name: Hostile Takeover
achievements.description: Capture an enemy ship.

achievements.name: That Belongs in a Museum!
achievements.description: Collect an artifact during a War Games session.

achievements.name: Big Game Hunter
achievements.description: Eliminate 50 total enemy capital ships.

achievements.name: The Great Cannon
achievements.description: Unlock the mothership's Fusion Missile through research.

achievements.name: The Unbound
achievements.description: Research your first ship upgrade.

achievements.name: Not Today, Singularity!
achievements.description: Win a Skirmish match consisting of at least 3 enemy AI opponents.

achievements.name: Destruct Sequence Alpha-One
achievements.description: Scuttle one of your own ships.

achievements.name: If You’ll Be My Bodyguard
achievements.description: Order a ship to guard another ship.

achievements.name: Stay in formation!
achievements.description: Set a command group to assume a new formation.

achievements.name: Grand Armada
achievements.description: Build a grand total of 500 ships.

achievements.name: We Are Away
achievements.description: Put the Khar-Kushan through its paces (Mission 1).

achievements.name: A Helluva Ship
achievements.description: Integrate the production facility into the mothership (Mission 2).

achievements.name: Into the Glacier
achievements.description: Navigate the icy crevasse (a Mission 10 objective).

achievements.name: Ghosts Of The Desert
achievements.description: Enter the Ice Shelf without the mothership being detected (an optional Mission 10 objective).

achievements.name: Nothing Short Of Miraculous
achievements.description: Eliminate the Incarnate reinforcement fleet (an optional Mission 10 objective).

achievements.name: Warriors Of The Fringe
achievements.description: Defeat the Kalan Raider Carrier (Mission 3).

achievements.name: One Step Too Close
achievements.description: Encounter a new, mysterious enemy (Mission 4).

achievements.name: Open The Way
achievements.description: Disable the Citadel (Mission 8).

achievements.name: As They Have Hunted Us
achievements.description: Defeat the Warsage (Mission 9).

achievements.name: The Sajuuk-Khar
achievements.description: Reunite with the Khar-Sajuuk (Mission 11).

achievements.name: The Time Of Prophecy
achievements.description: Witness the enemy using a Hyperspace Tunnel (Mission 12).

achievements.name: This War Is Over
achievements.description: Complete the campaign by defeating the Incarnate Titan (Mission 13).

achievements.name: A Dark Cloud Gathers
achievements.description: Uncover the enemy's identity (Mission 5).

achievements.name: Prepare To Shipbreak
achievements.description: Ward off enemies during core repairs (Mission 7).

achievements.name: Fix-it Frigate
achievements.description: Fully repair 50 ships using Support Frigates.

achievements.name: Kablammo
achievements.description: Blow up 5 ships with one explosion.

achievements.name: That Was One in a Million!
achievements.description: Land the final shot to destroy a Capital ship with a Fleet Bomber ship.

achievements.name: A Path Across the Galaxy
achievements.description: In Campaign, have a (non-mothership) ship built in Facility 315 survive all the way through until the end of the campaign.
